title: Guidelines No 040/2024 of 25/11/2024 on the disclosure and reporting of sustainability-related financial information for financial institutions
citation: National Bank of Rwanda, Guidelines No 040/2024 of 25/11/2024 (listed at https://www.bnr.rw/regulatoryframework)
evidence: Art. 14: "These guidelines come into force on the date of its signature." Signed "Done at Kigali, 25th November 2024" by the Governor (digital signature on the PDF). Art. 12(1): "The Central Bank shall enforce compliance by Financial Institutions to the provisions of these guidelines." Art. 12(2): "Non-compliance with the provisions of these guidelines may lead to supervisory corrective actions."
notes: Phased IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards reporting for BNR-regulated financial institutions (Tier I from financial years starting 2025, Tier II and III from 2026, full standards from 2028 and 2029 per Annex A); art. 13(1) says financial institutions "shall implement these guidelines in phases". Secondary law-firm guides in the brief said Article 5 and Article 27; the official text has 14 articles and no Article 27. The text is uncorrected OCR output (tesseract 5, English, 300 dpi) of a scanned official PDF: the PDF text layer holds only the "BNR RESTRICTED" page labels and two tables, so pdftotext is not usable. Every page carries the label "BNR RESTRICTED" in the source. English only: BNR publishes no Kinyarwanda or French version. The brief placed this row on the annual report URL; it is replaced by the guideline PDF.

title: Rwanda Stock Exchange ESG Reporting Guidelines (manual for issuers listed on the RSE)
citation: Rwanda Stock Exchange, ESG Reporting Guidelines, PDF https://rse.rw/uploads/reports/1762874102_848234ff5c87f7d360c3.pdf
evidence: No official page states a commencement date. The PDF (49 pages, creation date 2024-10-31) says: "Listed companies on the RSE are to report on their ESG performance at least annually." and "Listed companies will have a grace period of one year from the issuance of the guideline". The brief gives a launch on 19/12/2024 from a press release; that page was not seen.
notes: Exchange guidance for RSE-listed issuers, GRI-aligned, prepared by a consultancy for the RSE with GRI and SECO support. Whether it is a binding listing requirement or voluntary was not settled: the manual uses "are to report" for listed companies and "recommended" elsewhere, and states no sanction. The PDF is copyrighted ("No part of this document ... shall be copied or reproduced for commercial purposes without the written consent of RSE").
status_note: Row RW-RSE-ESG is permission requested; text not stored.
